notes: Wikimedia Commons specimen, CC BY-SA 4.0, description states 'This specimen is for illustrative purposes only and does not contain any real personal information'. Original is PNG; losslessly wrapped into a 1-page PDF (no text layer - OCR required). UIDAI's own enrolment Form 1 was fetched too but classified xx_unknown_form (0.42) - an enrolment form is not an Aadhaar card, so it was discarded rather than mislabelled.
Companies Act 2013 Schedule I, Table F (model Articles of Association of a company limited by shares) - pages 7-23 of the India Code Schedule I PDF. Classifies in_aoa 0.90.

Official blank Form No. 5 (BIRTH CERTIFICATE / जन्म प्रमाण-पत्र) under the Registration of Births and Deaths Act 1969, extracted from the RGI Civil Registration System all-forms PDF. Bilingual Hindi/English. Classifies in_birth_certificate 0.90. Caveat: most Hindi is in a legacy non-Unicode font so it extracts as mojibake - useful as a Devanagari OCR test, less useful for text-layer anchor matching.
HSBC India published blank draft board-resolution format for corporate banking. All party names/dates are placeholders. Classifies in_board_resolution 0.90.

Railway Recruitment Cell, Eastern Railway - official blank proformas for SC/ST caste certificate, OBC community certificate and PwBD certificate (GoI standard Annexure formats). Classifies in_caste_certificate 0.90.

Blank Form INC-11 Certificate of Incorporation (GOVERNMENT OF INDIA / MINISTRY OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS / Central Registration Centre), all fields as <name of the company> placeholders. Mirror copy - mca.gov.in is behind an Akamai WAF that blocks non-browser clients and its deep links redirect to the home page. Classifier abstains at 0.603 (floor 0.65) with in_certificate_incorporation as top candidate; the doc is short (2051 chars) which caps coverage.

Blank CERSAI 'Central KYC Registry - Know Your Customer (KYC) Application Form for Individual', as published by Axis Bank. Classifier abstains at 0.634 (floor 0.65) but matches the decisive anchor 'CENTRAL KYC REGISTRY' and puts in_ckyc_record top - a good near-threshold regression case.

Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989, FORM 7 [see rule 16(2)] - 'FORM FOR DRIVING LICENCE (LAMINATED/SMART CARD TYPE)', i.e. the prescribed blank layout of the Indian DL itself, not an application form. Pages 273-275 of the CMVR PDF. Classifies in_driving_licence 0.90.
Blank FORM NO. 16 published by TRACES (TDS Reconciliation Analysis and Correction Enabling System, Income Tax Department). Classifies in_form16 0.90.

Blank FORM NO. 60 [second proviso to rule 114B] hosted by the Directorate of Registration & Stamp Revenue, Government of West Bengal. incometaxindia.gov.in is WAF-blocked. Classifies in_form60 0.66 (just over the floor). Bank-published variants (Bank of Baroda, DBS, HSBC, RBL) were also fetched but all scored lower (0.33-0.44) because bank branding dilutes the lexical profile - this cleaner copy was kept.
Blank FORM GST REG-06 (Registration Certificate) [see rule 10(1)], pages 35-38 of the CBIC CGST Rules 2017 Part-B FORMS compendium. Classifies in_gst_certificate 0.90.

Official blank FORM ITR-V 'INDIAN INCOME TAX RETURN VERIFICATION FORM' from incometaxindia.gov.in. Fetched through a real Chromium (the site's Akamai WAF rejects curl by TLS fingerprint). Classifies in_itr_acknowledgement 0.90.

Hindu Marriage Registration Rules 1973 as published by the Inspector General of Registration & Stamps, Uttar Pradesh - includes the blank Form A application and the prescribed marriage-certificate/register forms. Classifies in_marriage_certificate 0.90.
Companies Act 2013 Schedule I, Tables A-E (model Memorandum of Association) - pages 1-6 of the India Code Schedule I PDF. Classifies in_moa 0.90.

Blank National Population Register Schedule published by the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India. Scanned - no text layer, OCR required. Not classifier-verified for that reason.

ANNEXURE B-2 'FORMAT FOR JOB CARD' (cover page + inner pages) from the MGNREGA Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Rural Development, hosted by DRDA Puducherry. Pages 115-117. Deliberately NOT taken from nrega.nic.in's job-card reports, which are real households' cards. Classifies in_nrega_job_card 0.90.

'FORMAT OF DRAFT PARTNERSHIP DEED' published by the Department of Registration, Government of Goa. All names/dates/amounts are blanks. Classifies in_partnership_deed 0.90. Note: the host's TLS certificate is expired, so the fetch needed -k; content was verified after download.

Blank FORM No. II (see Rule 3) under the Indian Partnership Act 1932 - Registrar of Firms filing. CAVEAT: this is the statement filed WITH the Registrar of Firms, not the certificate of registration the Registrar issues back; no privacy-safe copy of the issued certificate exists (every real one names real partners). Classifier abstains at 0.612 with in_partnership_reg_cert top, driven by the 'REGISTRAR OF FIRMS' anchor. Treat as a weak positive.

Central Pension Accounting Office circular 'Implementation of Revised format of PPO Booklet (CAM-52)' - carries the full blank bilingual (Hindi/English) PPO booklet format, all fields empty. Scanned - no text layer, OCR required, so not classifier-verified. Visually confirmed blank (page 2 shows 'Pay & Accounts Officer', 'Family Pension Normal Rate', 'Copy Forwarded to: 1.Pensioner 2.PAO' with no values).

'Sample Design of Smart Ration Card' published by the Department of Food Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Government of NCT of Delhi. Scanned - no text layer, OCR required. A second page of the same sample is available at .../2.ration_card-page-0.pdf and classifies in_ration_card 0.90 on its (thin, 245-char) text layer.

Official draft LEAVE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT template from the Maharashtra IGR e-registration portal (Department of Registration & Stamps). All parties/amounts are (Name)/(Amount)/(Date) placeholders. Classifies in_rent_agreement 0.90. The Model Tenancy Act 2021 First Schedule was the first choice but every mohua.gov.in URL for it now 404s.

Blank FORM XIX 'Wage Slip' under Rule 78(1)(b) of the A.P. Contract Labour (R&A) Rules 1971, published by the Telangana Labour Department - the only statutory blank pay-slip form in India. FAILS CLASSIFICATION at 0.11: the registry's decisive anchors for in_salary_slip are SALARY SLIP / PAY SLIP / PAYSLIP / वेतन पर्ची / SALARY STATEMENT, and the statutory Indian term 'WAGE SLIP' (and 'मजदूरी पर्ची') is absent from the anchor set. Recommend adding those anchors; kept here as the regression case that proves the gap.

Annexure IV model/specimen domestic electricity bill from 'Standardization of Electricity Bill, July 2015' by the Forum of Regulators (statutory body under s.166 Electricity Act 2003). Fabricated data throughout ('ABC DISTCOM', 'Mr. A. Kumar'). Pages 16-17. Classifies in_utility_electricity 0.72.

Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission Public Awareness Bulletin-12, 'Sample Electricity Bill for a Group Housing Society'. Classifies in_utility_electricity 0.90. Second exemplar for the same doctype.

Deloitte Special Projects India Pvt Ltd (CIN U74140TG2014PTC094207), MGT-7A abridged annual return as filed with the RoC, published on Deloitte's own site. Header reads 'FORM NO. MGT-7A' verbatim; classifies in_mca_mgt7_annual_return 0.766. Chosen over four other real MGT-7 filings (Morgan Stanley India Primary Dealer, NERL, BofA Securities India, NPCI) because MCA V3 prints the signing director's and certifying professional's INDIVIDUAL PAN on the plain MGT-7 and those were rejected as personal data; MGT-7A is abridged and carries only the company PAN (AAFCK5379L).

Blank MCA e-form AOC-4 ('FORM NO. AOC-4 / Form for filing financial statement and other documents with the Registrar'), 8 pages with a full text layer. Mirror, not the regulator's own host: mca.gov.in serves e-form PDFs behind an Akamai bot check that returns 403 to any non-browser client, so the MCA e-forms in this batch all come from public mirrors of the MCA-issued file. Classifies in_mca_aoc4_financial_statements 0.766.

Blank MCA e-form DIR-12 (2024 revision), 6 pages, text layer intact. Classifies in_mca_dir12 0.766. A real filed DIR-12 was found too (BSE announcement bsmedia.business-standard.com/_media/bs/data/announcements/bse/06032019/a339f851-9afa-421a-9307-3d2b492c28c0.pdf, classified in_mca_dir12 0.766) but was DISCARDED: DIR-12 carries each director's individual PAN, date of birth and father's name, which is personal data about the individual rather than corporate-officer information.

Blank MCA e-form PAS-3 (Return of Allotment), 10 pages, text layer intact. Classifies in_mca_pas3 0.766. Mirror of the MCA-issued form — see the AOC-4 note on why mca.gov.in itself is unreachable from a non-browser client.
Blank MCA e-form SH-7 ('Notice to Registrar of any alteration of share capital'), 6 pages, text layer intact. Classifies in_mca_sh7 0.766.
Blank MCA e-form CHG-1 ('Application for registration of creation, modification of charge'), 6 pages, text layer intact. Classifies in_mca_chg1 0.766.

Blank MCA e-form INC-20A ('Declaration for commencement of business'), text layer intact. Classifies in_mca_inc20a 0.766. A second INC-20A copy (ca2013.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Form-INC-20A.pdf) was rejected — it is a flattened scan with no text layer at all.

Central Depository Services (India) Ltd, shareholding pattern as on 30 June 2017 filed under SEBI LODR Regulation 31, from CDSL's own investor-relations page. 7 pages. Classifies in_shareholding_pattern 0.766. Shareholder names here are institutions and promoter entities, not individuals with addresses.

Bharat Dynamics Ltd, quarterly compliance report on corporate governance for Q2 FY2021-22 under SEBI LODR Regulation 27(2), from the company's own site. Classifies in_corporate_governance_report 0.766.
SEBI's own published BRSR reporting format (Annexure II, updated July 2023) — the regulator's host, which is the preferred source under the sourcing rules. 41 pages. Classifies in_brsr 0.765.
Colgate-Palmolive (India) Ltd, BRSR filed as Annexure 6 to the FY2024 annual report, from the company's investor site. A real filled BRSR against the blank format above. Classifies in_brsr 0.765.

Uno Minda Ltd BRSR FY2025-26 as filed with NSE (nsearchives = NSE's own archive). KEPT DELIBERATELY BECAUSE IT ABSTAINS. Both in_brsr decisive anchors match ('BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITY AND SUSTAINABILITY REPORT' and 'National Guidelines on Responsible Business Conduct'), the evidence leader is in_brsr with 10.65 bits of separation, and the service still returns unknown: over 185k characters the lexical channel leans in_mca_mgt7_annual_return (a BRSR annexure to an annual report is full of turnover, share-capital and shareholding language), the two channels disagree, and neither tier may accept alone. Reported to the lead, not worked around here.

Infosys Ltd standalone independent auditor's report FY2019-20 (Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP), published standalone by Infosys — 6 pages, so the CARO annexure is a large fraction of the document. Classifies in_statutory_auditor_report 0.766.

Titan Company Ltd FY2019-20 standalone financial statements with the independent auditor's report and CARO annexure at the front. The opposite shape from the Infosys file: the auditor's report is a small header on a long financial-statements document, which is the harder case. Classifies in_statutory_auditor_report 0.765.
Reliance Industries Ltd — secretarial audit reports in Form MR-3 for its material subsidiaries, published on RIL's own site. Classifies in_secretarial_audit_mr3 0.766.

Ashoka Buildcon Ltd — Form MR-3 secretarial audit report filed as Annexure V to the board's report. Different practising-company-secretary firm and a different house style from the RIL file. Classifies in_secretarial_audit_mr3 0.766.

RBI's own published Form FC-GPR — Annex I to A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 102 of 11.02.2014, from rbidocs.rbi.org.in. Blank form, 8 pages. The regulator's own host, which is the preferred source. Classifies in_fema_fcgpr 0.758.
